mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_CD AS roleCd, ROLE_NM AS roleNm, ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel, USE_YN AS useYn FROM com_role WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ROLE_LEVEL
